Pre-claim lane: domain:server area S4 (E1), by the seat's assignment on 2026-11-16 (the writer of `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`). #34226, #34247, #34248 and #33210 stay with S5.
Pre-claim deps: none open (no Blocked-by).
Prior rulings read: ADR-0150 D3 (a disabled package holds no name) and D4; ruling 6893582352 on #33264 ("a disabled holder: no refusal"); PR #34036 (two enabled holders of a doc → 409); fold PR #33995 (`_env` in the same file).

Claim amendment 2026-11-16T05:46Z (claim 6906988332), answering the dev's open question in report 6908448767. Option A is taken.
File surface: adds the two `/published` door twins, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`. Each gets a one-conjunct edit, so that the mixed-owner arm covers the types `servedHolderAddressOf` now re-addresses. The pin files are `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (the #34040 type enumeration) and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts`. Acceptance item 1 names `/published`, and the face fix alone would move it from 404 to the disabled holder's body. So the door half lands in the same PR: one rule, no two-lap no-op PR.
Scope: per acceptance item 2, every type the registry does not read by package except `object`, `action` (`judgeBareActionRead` already serves the enabled holder) and `package`.
Declaration kept: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. A disabled holder's body stops being served at `/layers` `effective` and at `/published`, and the enabled holder's item is served instead (ADR-0150 D3). Nothing served becomes refused, as measured. L1 checks this reading.
Serial: merge-tree runs against origin/main and every open PR touching the two door files before the push.
